faq_subtitle: Clear answers so you can decide calmly.

faqs.q: What can I do in the 7-day trial?
faqs.a: Organize your class, take attendance on mobile, and prepare the next meeting — your real weekly workflow. No card and no charge now.

faqs.q: Do I need a card for the trial?
faqs.a: No. The 7-day trial does not ask for a card. A card is only required if you decide to subscribe later.

faqs.q: What happens when the 7 days end?
faqs.a: Nothing is charged — you never entered a card. If you want to continue, you subscribe to the Catechist Plan on the Pricing page. If not, your account simply stops there.

faqs.q: Do I need my parish to get started?
faqs.a: No. The account is yours and the class is yours: you create it, organize it, and use it without depending on coordination. Parishes and dioceses join the platform in a future phase.
Yes, in the mobile browser — nothing to install. Attendance is built for use during the meeting.

faqs.q: Can I import my class spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes. You can import catechumens in bulk and skip starting from zero.
Yes. Access control, consent flows, and LGPD-oriented features are built in.
